name: @fusion.dev/site
description: fusion.dev: the landing page, the verticals, and the tools under them.

scripts.build: bun run themed-page && bun run catalog && bun run frame && bun run specs && next build
scripts.dev: bun run --filter @fusion.dev/helix-theme wasm && bun run themed-page && bun run catalog && bun run frame && bun run specs && next dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run themed-page && bun run catalog && bun run frame && bun run specs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
